lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 resolved the reviewer's WARNING on subagent-implementer.md:169: US-003 had silently dropped `.githooks/**` from the implementer's 'must not touch' Constraints line to make the new validate-agents-md doc-as-code gate green (that path never resolves on disk in this repo -- core.hooksPath is the default .git/hooks, never .githooks/). Per the reviewer's explicit preference ('prefer preserving intent over deleting a guardrail to make a linter green'), restored `.githooks/**` to `.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md`'s Constraints line and added a matching KNOWN_MISSING allowlist entry in scripts/validate-agents-md.ts (pattern `.githooks/**`, reason citing the core.hooksPath default) instead of re-deleting the token. `bun scripts/validate-agents-md.ts` confirmed exit 0 with the new entry marked used (not unused). Along the way, found (but did NOT need to fix, since it predates and is out of this story's scope) a pre-existing dual-copy drift: `templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md` (the cam init seed copy) still carried `.githooks/**` the whole time -- only the self-hosted `.claude/` copy had lost it -- because validate-agents-md's scan surface deliberately excludes templates/. No further action needed there since the templates/ copy was never wrong. Full `bun run check:all` (all 12 gates) and `bun test` (4509 pass / 0 fail) are green. No more R1 review-fix stories are known to be queued in prd.json at this point; check prd.json for the next story.
